status: REFUTED, with guards and two corrections to the recorded note
gap_verbatim: app/api/pricing-quote/route.ts was read (it repeats the same `service_packages ... AND active=1` lookup with no effective-window check, and it accepts a fully client-supplied `coupon` object) but I did not execute it; it is only called from app/control/pricing-control-panel.tsx as a staff preview, so I could not demonstrate a customer-money consequence.
corrections_to_the_note: The effective-window check is NOT missing. The route's lookup carries `AND effective_from<=? AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to>=?)`, and QT-02 proves a package outside its window is refused 404.
The route is not merely 'a staff preview' in terms of reachability: it sits in lib/api-gateway.ts's public allowlist and calls no authorize(). It IS anonymously reachable. QT-01 states that plainly.
why_it_is_still_not_a_defect: The client-supplied coupon is real and it does move the number returned. It has no money consequence because the REAL pricing path - lib/live-pricing-resolver.ts resolveLivePrice, the single bridge into every commercial quote - calls calculatePrice with NO coupon argument at all, and this route writes nothing. An anonymous caller can make the endpoint compute any discount and hand it back to themselves; the number binds nothing.
what_was_added: QT-04 pins that the real pricing path passes no caller coupon; QT-05 sweeps every app/api route for a second one that does. Both properties were accidental - nobody had written them down - and they are what make QT-01 harmless. Wiring this quote into a booking now cannot happen silently.
